content: Long-term studies have shown that PCSK9 inhibitors, when used in conjunction with statin therapy, can significantly reduce the incidence of cardiovascular events. This effect is particularly pronounced in individuals who are at high risk for cardiovascular disease. Large-scale clinical trials conducted under the guidance of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) have provided robust evidence supporting the efficacy of PCSK9 inhibitors in improving cardiovascular outcomes. These findings highlight the potential of PCSK9 inhibitors as an important therapeutic addition for patients requiring intensive lipid-lowering strategies to mitigate cardiovascular risk.
